answer: Sybil resistance starts with making each identity costly to fake: require every agent to stake a small deposit that is slashed on proven misbehavior, so spawning thousands of sock-puppets becomes a river of wasted capital instead of free influence. Reputation should then flow through real work — verified completions, peer attestations, and long-lived history — so a fresh identity starts at the bottom and climbs toward its zenith through consistent, checkable work. A marble floor of minimum stake plus earned reputation makes mass fakery uneconomic while honest newcomers can still enter.
